tools.name: read_url
tools.description: Use this when you need clean Markdown + metadata from a public URL (not raw HTML). Returns title, author, date, language, word_count, markdown, links. Better for RAG/summaries than fetch. Example: {url:"https://example.com"}. $0.002 USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: extract_links
tools.description: Use this when you only need de-duplicated absolute links (crawl maps). Cheaper/faster than read_url. Example: {url} → {count, links:[{url,text,internal}]}. $0.001 USDC.

tools.name: check_domain
tools.description: Use this when vetting domain health before outreach: DNS (DoH), DNSSEC, TLS/HTTPS, HSTS, MX/SPF/DMARC, issues + score. Structured JSON beats shell dig/openssl. Example: {domain:"stripe.com"}. $0.001 USDC.

tools.name: company_research
tools.description: Use this when researching a company from its website domain (not UK Companies House). Sourced tech stack, socials, emails/phones, DNS/MX/SPF/DMARC, RDAP, SSL, sitemap, news — no LLM fiction. Example: {domain:"stripe.com"}. Prefer uk_company* for UK filings. $0.25 USDC.

tools.name: uk_company
tools.description: Use this for full UK Companies House due diligence (number or name): profile, officers, PSCs, filings, charges, insolvency + red flags (overdue, dissolved, officer churn, mass-formation office). Official API with public fallback. Example: {number:"00445790"}. Prefer uk_company_lite ($0.05) for statu

tools.name: uk_company_lite
tools.description: Use this for a cheap UK company snapshot: status, SIC, office, compliance overdue, mass-formation check, red flags. Example: {number:"00445790"}. Upsell uk_company for officers/PSC/filings/charges/insolvency. $0.05 USDC.

tools.name: company_full
tools.description: Use this for website company research + UK Companies House pack in one call ($0.65 vs $0.75 separate). Attaches UK DD when .uk TLD or CH number detected; optional Charity Commission lite attach for .org.uk / charity signals. Example: {domain:"tesco.com"} → {company, uk, uk_included}. $0.65 USDC.

tools.name: uk_charity
tools.description: Use this for a cheap UK charity snapshot (Charity Commission E&W): status, registration/removal, income/spending, trustees count, website, activities. Lookup by registered number or name. OGL v3. Example: {number:"1089464"}. Upsell uk_charity_full. $0.05 USDC.

tools.name: uk_charity_full
tools.description: Use this for full UK charity due diligence: trustees, 5-year finances, assets/liabilities, governance, areas of operation, regulatory/insolvency flags, linked charities, other names + red-flag summary. OGL v3. Example: {number:"1089464"}. $0.25 USDC.

tools.name: convert_document
tools.description: Use this when converting a public PDF/DOCX/HTML/text URL to markdown or plain text for RAG/summaries. Example: {url, format:"markdown"} → {detected_format, markdown, pages, word_count}. $0.03 USDC.

tools.name: create_monitor
tools.description: Use this for 30 days of hourly web change monitoring with webhook alerts (pricing/status/jobs pages). Returns id; GET /monitor/:id is free. Example: {url, webhook, selector?}. $1.00 USDC.

tools.name: wallet_balances
tools.description: Use this when you need an EVM wallet's balances in one call: native ETH/POL + USDC/USDT/DAI/WETH/cbBTC/EURC (+ up to 10 custom ERC20 addresses comma-separated), nonce, is_contract. Chains: base (default), ethereum, arbitrum, optimism, polygon. $0.003 USDC.

tools.name: tx_status
tools.description: Use this to verify a transaction or payment landed: status success/reverted/pending, block, timestamp, confirmations, from/to, value, fee, decoded ERC20 transfers (USDC amounts). Chains: base (default), ethereum, arbitrum, optimism, polygon. $0.003 USDC.

tools.name: token_check
tools.description: Use this before buying, accepting or listing an ERC20 token: name/symbol/supply, owner renounced?, upgradeable proxy, DEX price/liquidity/volume/pair age + rule-based risk flags, 0-100 score and verdict. Not financial advice. $0.01 USDC.

tools.name: fx_rates
tools.description: Use this for official ECB currency exchange rates (~30 fiat incl GBP/EUR/USD/JPY), latest or a historical date (YYYY-MM-DD), with optional amount conversion. $0.002 USDC.

tools.name: ens_lookup
tools.description: Use this to resolve an ENS name to an address plus avatar/url/twitter/github/description records, or reverse-resolve an address to its forward-verified primary name. Pass name OR address. $0.002 USDC.

tools.name: token_metadata
tools.description: Use this when you only need an ERC20's name, symbol, decimals and total supply (formatted + raw), e.g. to format amounts. Cheaper than token_check. Chains: base (default), ethereum, arbitrum, optimism, polygon. $0.001 USDC.

tools.name: token_allowance
tools.description: Use this before transferFrom/Permit/x402 flows or for approval hygiene: ERC20 allowance owner->spender, unlimited flag, owner balance, spendable-now. Chains: base (default), ethereum, arbitrum, optimism, polygon. $0.002 USDC.

tools.name: contract_info
tools.description: Use this to inspect an address: contract vs wallet vs EIP-7702 delegated EOA, bytecode size, EIP-1967 implementation/admin/beacon, EIP-1167 clone target, owner(), ERC20/721/1155 detection, Sourcify verified name. Chains: base (default), ethereum, arbitrum, optimism, polygon. $0.003 USDC.

tools.name: gas_fees
tools.description: Use this before sending a transaction: base fee, priority-fee percentiles, suggested EIP-1559 maxFee/maxPriority, block utilisation and USD cost of a transfer, ERC20 transfer and swap. Chains: base (default), ethereum, arbitrum, optimism, polygon. $0.001 USDC.

tools.name: block_lookup
tools.description: Use this to fetch a block by number/latest/finalized, or find the last block at or before a timestamp (unix or ISO) for historical queries. Returns number, hash, time, tx count, base fee. Chains: base (default), ethereum, arbitrum, optimism, polygon. $0.001 USDC.

tools.name: nft_lookup
tools.description: Use this to look up one NFT: ERC721 owner, tokenURI and fetched JSON metadata (IPFS/Arweave/data URIs resolved), collection name/symbol. Chains: base (default), ethereum, arbitrum, optimism, polygon. $0.002 USDC.

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Use this for cheap research search over open sources: Wikipedia + OpenAlex + arXiv + Crossref, merged, deduplicated and ranked with snippets, authors, dates, DOIs, citations. Not a general web index. Pass q (and optional sources, limit). $0.003 USDC.

tools.name: uk_property_prices
tools.description: Use this for England & Wales house prices near a UK postcode: HM Land Registry Price Paid sales (address, price, date, type, tenure) within radius metres, plus medians. OGL. $0.01 USDC.

tools.name: uk_area_profile
tools.description: Use this for a UK postcode profile: ONS geography and codes, lat/lon, police street crime last month by category, FSA food hygiene mix nearby. OGL. $0.005 USDC.

tools.name: pricing
tools.description: Free: list Axiom Works AgentReader tools, prices, when-to-use hints and payment details.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: read_url, extract_links, check_domain, create_monitor · Private data: convert_document, wallet_balances, token_check, ens_lookup, token_metadata, token_allowance, contract_info · Public sink: create_monitor, ens_lookup · Destructive: convert_document, token_metadata.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: read_url, extract_links, check_domain, create_monitor · Private data: convert_document, wallet_balances, token_check, ens_lookup, token_metadata, token_allowance, contract_info · Public sink: create_monitor, ens_lookup · Destructive: convert_document, token_metadata

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
